hero.h1: Flooring and Tile Installation by Gabe and Molly
hero.subheadline: Kurtz Flooring Solutions replaces worn floors with new plank flooring, sets porcelain tile in bathrooms and kitchens, and explains how the job will go before the first board goes down.

image.alt: Kitchen with a linear glass and stone-look mosaic backsplash, speckled gray counters and a stainless range, flooring and tile installation by Kurtz

intro.h2: Flooring and tile installation, explained before the work starts
paragraphs: Kurtz Flooring Solutions, LLC handles flooring and tile installation, from long runs of plank flooring down a hallway to porcelain tile around a bathtub. One homeowner says Gabe and Molly educated her about her house and how replacing the floors would go, which made the whole job easy for her.

Another family hired Kurtz after a nightmare experience with a previous contractor and had their bathroom floor and tub and shower surround redone in porcelain tile. They say Gabriel takes his time, does it right and is an extremely honest person, and he even fixed a flooring job the homeowner had attempted around the fireplace.

items.name: Plank floor replacement
items.blurb: Old carpet and worn floors give way to plank flooring that runs straight down hallways, through doorways and into kitchens and dining rooms, with tidy edges at every threshold. New floors come up in three Google reviews, and one client says Kurtz made the whole replacement easy.

image.alt: Gray oak-look plank flooring running down a hallway past several doorways

items.name: Hardwood floor installation
items.blurb: Hardwood installation is a topic in two Google reviews. If you want real wood in a living room or bedroom, call to talk through the boards, the layout and the condition of your subfloor, so the plan fits your house before any material is ordered.

image.alt: Living room with a new honey-toned oak hardwood floor and white baseboards

items.name: Porcelain tile bathrooms and tub surrounds
items.blurb: One family had their bathroom floor and tub and shower surround redone in porcelain tile and says it came out beautiful. Tile in a wet area takes patience at every corner and cut, which is how clients describe Gabriel: he takes his time and does it right.

image.ai_prompt: Photorealistic photo of a small remodeled bathroom in a single-story American ranch home: a white bathtub with a floor-to-ceiling surround of large light gray porcelain tile laid in a running bond, a matching porcelain tile floor, a white shaker vanity with a marble-look top, a chrome shower head, in warm gray, walnut brown and warm white, soft natural light from a small window, clean and finished, no people, no faces, no text, no logos, no brand names, 4:3
image.alt: Bathroom with a light gray porcelain tile tub surround and matching tile floor

items.name: Kitchen tile and backsplashes
items.blurb: Kitchen tile is another topic in Kurtz's Google reviews. In this kitchen, a linear glass and stone-look mosaic runs behind the range, turns the corner and tucks neatly under the wood cabinets, tying the speckled gray counters to the warm cabinetry.

about.text: Kurtz Flooring Solutions, LLC is the flooring and tile business clients know as Gabe and Molly. Gabriel does the installing and, in one client's words, takes pride in his work and is not satisfied until it is right. Molly is named beside him in reviews as part of a team that stays very communicative throughout the process. Google lists the business as a general contractor, and its reviews talk about new floors, hardwood installation, tiling and kitchen tile. You can reach them any day of the week.

process.h2: How a Kurtz flooring job works

steps.title: Call any day
steps.text: Call (501) 993-2105 any day from 8 AM to 6 PM, or email kurtzflooringsolutionsllc@gmail.com, and say which rooms need new floors or tile.

steps.title: Learn what your house needs
steps.text: Gabe and Molly look at the space and explain how the process will go, the way one client says they educated her about her house.

steps.title: Get your quote
steps.text: Reviewers say the quotes come back fast. You agree on the flooring, the tile and the price before any old floor comes up.

steps.title: Install with care
steps.text: Gabriel takes his time on the install and works around kids, questions and even curious dogs until the job is done right.

steps.title: Walk the new floors
steps.text: Walk through the finished rooms together. Clients say Kurtz will be their first call for any future flooring needs.

items.name: Elizabeth B.
items.text: If you are ever looking for someone to do your floors I would highly recommend them. They were very professional they educated me about my house and how the process will go replacing the floors. They made it easy for me stress free Gabe & Molly are super knowledgeable and great people to be around. Highly recommended them and they were fast on their quotes.

items.name: Matt T.
items.text: If I could give 10 stars out of 5 I would. Gabriel and Molly were great and very communicative throughout the entire process. It was evident very early on the integrity that Gabriel has and the pride he takes in his work. He takes his time and he does it right. He's not satisfied unless it is done right and is an extremely honest person. We had a nightmare experience with a contractor before him so him and Molly were a breath of fresh air. We had Kurtz redo our bathroom floor and tub/shower surround with porcelain tile and it came out beautiful. He also fixed a bad flooring job (done by me) around our fireplace. Kurtz will absolute be our first call for any future flooring needs and I know there will be some. Please save yourself from searching for someone to do you flooring and use Kurtz. Highly recommended!!

items.name: Dena A.
items.text: If you are considering new floors this is the company to hire!! They work hard and are so kind. They answered all of my daughters many many questions and worked around two very nosy dogs! I am just blown away by their work ethic and they were a joy to have in our home!

service_area.text: Kurtz Flooring Solutions, LLC works at customers' homes, and Google shows no street address or list of towns for the business. To find out whether your home is in their area, call (501) 993-2105 any day between 8 AM and 6 PM, or send a message to kurtzflooringsolutionsllc@gmail.com with your town, the rooms you want done and the kind of floor or tile you have in mind.

items.q: What kinds of floors do you install?
items.a: Google reviews mention new floors, hardwood installation, tiling and kitchen tile, and the photos show plank flooring in hallways, kitchens and dining rooms. One family also had their bathroom floor and tub surround done in porcelain tile. Call (501) 993-2105 to describe the rooms you want to change.

items.q: Can you fix a floor someone else installed badly?
items.a: Yes. One client had Kurtz fix a bad flooring job around his fireplace that he had done himself, and his family hired Kurtz after a nightmare experience with an earlier contractor. Call to describe the problem, and send photos if you can.

items.q: How fast can I get a quote?
items.a: Reviewers say Kurtz is fast on their quotes. Call (501) 993-2105 or email kurtzflooringsolutionsllc@gmail.com with the rooms, their rough size and the type of floor you want, and Gabe and Molly can explain how the process would go in your house.

Yes. Kurtz Flooring Solutions, LLC is open every day of the week, Monday through Sunday, from 8 AM to 6 PM. That makes it easy to call after a weekday shift or on a Saturday morning while you are looking at your floors.

items.q: We have kids and pets. Is that a problem?
items.a: No. One client says the crew answered her daughter's many, many questions, worked around two very nosy dogs and was a joy to have in the home. Mention pets and family schedules when you call so the work can be planned around them.

final_cta.text: Call Gabe and Molly any day from 8 AM to 6 PM for a quote.
